data.narrative:
Figure AI, a Series C-stage AI & Software company founded by Brett Adcock, has raised over $1.0B to date and carries a stated valuation of $39B. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir), focused on same-sector and same-stage positioning.

Stage-progression analysis—typically applicable to early-stage venture rounds—was excluded here due to a sanity clamp. The stated $39B valuation, if carried forward with standard 1.7x Series C step-up mechanics, would imply $66.3B post-money, representing a >20x multiple on total capital raised. This ratio exceeds empirical venture norms and suggests the $39B figure may reflect a data-sourcing error rather than audited post-money economics.

Peer-median triangulation, applied across three same-stage, same-sector comparables (Skild AI at $14.0B, Crusoe Energy at $10.0B, and Together AI at $8.3B), yields a median valuation of $10.0B with a range of $8.3B–$14.0B. This method anchors the only defensible valuation signal in the dataset. The triangulated range of $8.5B to $11.5B (median $10.0B) reflects this peer distribution. Key uncertainty: the stated $39B remains unexplained and substantially diverges from peer-derived estimates, warranting source verification before investment decision-making.
